name: @brdndon/secure-mcp
description: Local MCP server for structured, agent-first security audits of TypeScript/Next.js and Swift/SwiftUI codebases

scripts.test: tsx --test src/config.test.ts src/server.test.ts src/knowledge/packs/registry.test.ts src/knowledge/packs/stack-isolation.test.ts src/knowledge/swift.test.ts src/knowledge/findings-schema.test.ts src/knowledge/common.test.ts src/knowledge/authz-graph.test.ts src/knowledge/threat-highlights.test.ts src/lib/filesystem.test.ts src/lib/coverage.test.ts src/lib/redact.test.ts src/lib/secret-tokens.test.ts src/tools/analyzeArchitecture.test.ts src/tools/analyzeInjectionRisks.test.ts src/tools/checkAuthentication.test.ts src/tools/listProjects.test.ts src/tools/runLocalScanners.test.ts src/tools/packRouting.test.ts src/tools/stack-isolation.test.ts src/tools/produceFindings.test.ts src/tools/reviewSecrets.test.ts src/tools/buildRemediationThreatModel.test.ts scripts/eval-audit.test.ts scripts/registry-metadata.test.ts scripts/modern-protocol.test.ts scripts/legacy-rejection.test.ts scripts/finding-schema-artifact.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm smoke
scripts.release:check: pnpm verify && pnpm docs:build && pnpm docs:check && pnpm docs:validate && pnpm audit:dependencies && pnpm test:installer && pnpm test:package && node scripts/check-release-identity.mjs
